capabilities: Hide text behind clickable display text
Copy hidden payload to clipboard on click
Show hidden payload in a hover tooltip
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not create links; clicking the display text copies hidden text to the clipboard instead of navigating.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to embed hidden text in a note that is revealed or copied only when the reader clicks the visible text.
summary: Syntax plugin that hides arbitrary text behind clickable display text and copies the hidden payload to the clipboard on click.
